services.desc: Looking for a fun and memorable outdoor activity the whole family can enjoy? A fishing charter in Virginia Beach and the Chesapeake Bay area offers the perfect way to connect with nature, learn a new skill, and create lasting memories - all while exploring the beautiful waters that this region is known for. At Captain Hogg’s Charters, we specialize in family-friendly fishing adventures aboard our spacious and comfortable boat, the Smokin’ Gun II. Fishing is an incredible activity for all ages. blurb: Guests fish year-round aboard the "Smokin' Gun II", a 40' custom-built Evans boat designed for comfort, speed, and safety. Charters are led by Captain Chandler Hogg and include half-day, full-day, or evening trips targeting species like cobia, red drum, black drum, striped bass, flounder, and trout. The boat is Coast Guard-certified for up to 32 passengers and equipped with top-tier fishing gear and electronics.
